scope: Primary sources used or directly tested; no exhaustive literature or priority claim.

sources.author: Charles M. Goldie
sources.title: Implicit Renewal Theory and Tails of Solutions of Random Equations
sources.use: Affine perpetuity theorem and tail constant, Theorem 4.1.
sources.access: Original full text inaccessible; theorem and constant checked through Alsmeyer's author manuscript, Proposition 4.2.
sources.status: Classical published theorem; exact hypotheses instantiated in RENEWAL_TRANSPORT.md.

sources.author: Gerold Alsmeyer
sources.title: On the stationary tail index of iterated random Lipschitz functions
sources.use: Propositions 4.1–4.2 reproduce the applicable Goldie statements and constant.

sources.author: Péter Kevei
sources.title: Implicit renewal theory in the arithmetic case
sources.use: Opening theorem and Section 2 distinguish centered arithmetic from translated lattice support.
sources.status: Used for the exact renewal hypothesis convention.

sources.author: Sara Brofferio
sources.title: The Poisson boundary of random rational affinities
sources.status: Applied to both original and tilted affine laws; no semigroup-generation or quasi-invariance assumption added.

sources.author: A. Gaudillière and C. Landim
sources.title: A Dirichlet principle for non reversible Markov chains and some recurrence theorems
sources.status: Hypotheses tested on actual operators. Strong sector condition disproved there; no directed recurrence import.

sources.author: Sébastien Gouëzel
sources.title: Martin boundary of random walks with unbounded jumps in hyperbolic groups
sources.status: Hypothesis comparison only; no theorem imported to the ordinary Collatz graph.

sources.author: Shigeki Akiyama, Christiane Frougny and Jacques Sakarovitch
sources.title: Powers of rationals modulo 1 and rational base number systems
sources.use: Proposition 13 and its finite carry recurrence.
sources.access: Author manuscript theorem and proof inspected.
sources.status: Motivates whole-source buffering; unrestricted output-digit normalization does not establish a legal Collatz splice.

sources.author: D. Buraczewski, J. F. Collamore, E. Damek and J. Zienkiewicz
sources.title: Large deviation estimates for exceedance times of perpetuity sequences and their dual processes
sources.access: Published statement checked in an author's uploaded article; direct author URL timed out.
sources.status: Not imported: published non-lattice hypothesis differs from the centered nonarithmetic hypothesis that does hold here.

sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.title: An exact real/3-adic tail identity at positive odd targets
sources.use: Prior exact joint-tail trace, all-depth bound and moving-source obstruction.
sources.access: Primary post read and finite-word identities reconstructed.
sources.status: Recent research post; credited prior calculation, not a universal theorem or new result of this pass.

sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.title: Ternary Syracuse laws: real localization, clock stability, and critical regularity
sources.use: Prior Proposition 11 tilted integer trace and stated tilted coding result.
sources.access: Primary manuscript read; the needed trace and coding conclusions have direct proofs in our note.
sources.status: Recent manuscript. Its stronger regularity, dimension and clock results are not imported as unchecked dependencies.

sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.title: Geometry, integer fibres, and dyadic equidistribution of the joint Collatz affine law
sources.use: Sections 9.2 and 10.6 considered for a joint-fibre or quotient route.
sources.status: Context and attempted application only; quotient discards integer-diagonal labels and its finite-cell estimates are not used to claim an ordinary pointwise bound.

sources.author: Bjorn Poonen
sources.title: p-adic interpolation of iterates
sources.status: Applies to the sibling map B on Z_3; does not supply regularity of G composed with its analytic interpolation.

sources.author: J.-H. Evertse, H. P. Schlickewei and W. M. Schmidt
sources.title: Linear equations in variables which lie in a multiplicative group
sources.use: Theorem 1.1, dependence on dimension and group rank.
sources.access: Published paper in primary arXiv archive read.
